rationale: ECB MFI list is a daily-updated machine-readable register; standalone entity spine for SK credit institutions.
Slovak Commercial Register is a durable searchable statutory register, not a sub-page of a covered parent.
RPO public JSON REST API under CC BY 4.0 — cleanest legal bulk entity-resolution source.
RUZ Open API gives ongoing mandatory financial-statement filings for all SK actors.
SIPS/TARGET-SK participant lists are a recurring authoritative payments-infrastructure signal.
NBS banking-statistics hub publishes on a fixed calendar; standalone despite many nbs.sk siblings.
AIFM register is one of many NBS register sub-pages; covered by monitoring the NBS registers parent.
UVO economic-operator/UBO registers are separately queryable and bridge register data to public contracting.
Open-data catalogue tag query is a discovery layer to mine once for licensed bulk datasets, then archive.
Third-party MiCA aggregator with low credibility and unclear licence; redundant to NBS/ESMA registers.
SBA member roster seeds the SK bank actor map; mine once and refresh rarely rather than monitor.
SBA self-regulation/standards section keeps producing sector-level standards that pre-empt EU payments rules.
EBF country page is a thin section of ebf.eu; monitor EBF publications parent instead.
LobbyFacts datacard updates with declared EU files, budget and meetings — recurring reveals-indirectly signal.
Slovak FinTech Association site publishes ongoing news on MiCA, sandbox and payments regulation debate.
SFA member directory maps non-bank PSPs and vendors; a one-time lead-mining pointer.
Slov-Lex MPK portal is the authoritative timestamped feed of drafts, comments and statutory deadlines.
LRV portal continuously publishes MPK evaluation documents naming commenters and dispositions.
SLASPO is a live association source on IRRD/DORA/AML files and a named MPK commenter.
SASS publishes positions on financial-market legal norms; standalone association site.
AFISP is the central voice on distribution/commission and consumer-protection regulation in SK.
ALS SR reacts to leasing/consumer-credit norms (CCD2) affecting bank-owned finance houses.
ASINS covers NPL and debt-collection regulation; low volume but on-scope standalone source.
Employer confederation files MPK positions, but URL is inferred — confirm liveness and financial-sector signal density.
FinStat entity page carries a change feed useful for validating association liveness and governance shifts.
LinkedIn company feed is valuable for early positions but login-gated and ToS-restricted for collection.
Facebook channel is low-credibility and access-restricted; largely redundant to the association website.
Crypto association relevant to MiCA/EMT implementation, but canonical domain is inferred — verify first.
EDFA carries SK fintech asks into EU consultations, but domain inferred and SK-specific yield uncertain.
